issues.issue: Edits a migration that has already shipped (committed on main, tagged v1.0.0) to add orders.currency; databases that already ran it never get the column. Needs a new migration instead.
Adds a NOT NULL phone column with no default to the existing customers table: fails on tables with rows (and always on SQLite), and the running release's inserts don't set it.
Renames customers.name in place while the code (Customer model, CustomerDirectory, factory) still uses name; breaks the running release. Needs add-copy-drop across releases.
Drops orders.notes while the code (Order::$fillable, CustomerDirectory::packingSlip) still uses it; loses data and breaks the running release.
down() is empty, so a rollback reports success without restoring the column (it should re-add notes or throw because the data is gone).
Uses the Eloquent Order model (and loads every matching row with get()) inside a migration; should use the query builder, batched.
change() without restating nullable() makes country NOT NULL on Laravel 11+, which fails or breaks writes because existing rows and the code have NULL countries.
